xg.gate_note: Leave-one-match-out calibration to 2026-27 provider xG. This is an in-season calibration, not an out-of-season holdout; the model is not a location xG and does not predict results.
xg.note: fxG is a team-match estimate from shots, shot zones and penalties. Provider xG is a different model and is shown separately. The model range is uncertainty in the estimate; the goals range is the spread of goals from the same chances. Neither is a result prediction.
